templates.name: Pain-Point Flow
templates.when_to_use: A reader feels a daily pain and wants the exact 4-step fix with before/after proof.
templates.dynamic: Moving arrows between steps, closed-loop return highway, traveling packets, upgrade arrow.

templates.name: Split-Path Divergence
templates.when_to_use: Two paths look identical at the start but diverge (security, reliability, compliance).
templates.dynamic: Green vs. red packet streams, purple control-intercept flows, pulsing invariant.

templates.name: Hub-and-Spoke Core
templates.when_to_use: One central engine with many orbiting subsystems (harness layers, platform services).
templates.dynamic: 10 spokes streaming packets into a pulsing core.

templates.name: Layered Stack
templates.when_to_use: Explain a platform from foundation to experience with guarantees per layer.
templates.dynamic: Request descends on the left rail, verified response ascends on the right rail.

templates.name: Closed-Loop Cycle
templates.when_to_use: A process repeats until a gate exits (agent loops, CI loops, retraining).
templates.dynamic: Packets orbit the loop arcs; entry and exit arrows; pulsing core.

templates.name: Sequence Diagram
templates.when_to_use: Show exactly who calls whom, in what order, including retry loops.
templates.dynamic: Numbered messages stream packets between lifelines; loop fragment highlighted.

templates.name: Decision Tree
templates.when_to_use: A routing policy or architectural decision with 2-3 gates.
templates.dynamic: YES/NO branches carry packets to color-coded outcomes.

templates.name: Benchmark Bars
templates.when_to_use: Before/after measurements with sources and deltas.
templates.dynamic: Bars grow on load; delta pills; methodology panel.

templates.name: Evolution Timeline
templates.when_to_use: How a field evolved and why each era's failure created the next architecture.
templates.dynamic: Packets travel the spine; era cards alternate above/below; pattern chain arrows.

templates.name: Refinement Funnel
templates.when_to_use: Large raw input is filtered through gates into a few promoted outputs.
templates.dynamic: Packets fall through the funnel; stage filters connect to annotation cards.

templates.name: 2x2 Quadrant Map
templates.when_to_use: Position options on two axes and show the migration path to the target quadrant.
templates.dynamic: Breathing dots, axis flows, dashed migration arrows with labels.

templates.name: Anatomy Callouts
templates.when_to_use: Explain each part of a prompt, brief, config, or payload and why it matters.
templates.dynamic: Leader packets flow from 6 callouts into the central artifact.

templates.name: Bad vs. Good Diff
templates.when_to_use: Show the naive implementation next to the production one, line by line.
templates.dynamic: Transformation arrows jump from the bad lines to the fixed lines.

templates.name: Audit Scorecard
templates.when_to_use: A pass/partial/fail audit with evidence and the next fixes.
templates.dynamic: Scan packet sweeps the rows; FAIL pills blink; gauge arc fills.

templates.name: Radial Mind Map
templates.when_to_use: Map a field: center topic, 6 branches, 18 grounded leaves.
templates.dynamic: Curved branch flows stream packets outward from a pulsing center.

templates.name: Maturity Heatmap
templates.when_to_use: Compare levels or options across capabilities with a highlighted recommendation.
templates.dynamic: Recommended column pulses with a vertical scan; color-graded cells.

templates.name: KPI Dashboard Tiles
templates.when_to_use: Six headline metrics with trend, delta, and measurement method.
templates.dynamic: Packets trace each sparkline from BEFORE to AFTER.

templates.name: Repo Tree Map
templates.when_to_use: Walk readers through a repository: file -> responsibility -> architectural tier.
templates.dynamic: Leader packets link tree rows to responsibility cards and tier badges.

templates.name: Myth vs. Reality
templates.when_to_use: Bust 5 common assumptions with evidence-backed realities.
templates.dynamic: GROUNDED FIX arrows carry packets from each myth to its reality.

templates.name: Radar Evaluation
templates.when_to_use: Compare two designs across 6 dimensions with a rubric.
templates.dynamic: Polygon grows into place while packets orbit its outline.

templates.name: Pattern Picker
templates.when_to_use: A reader asks 'should this be a chain, a router, parallel calls, an orchestrator, an evaluator loop, or an agent?'
templates.dynamic: Six live mini-schematics with packets; gate diamonds; feedback loops.
templates.lineage: Anthropic, Building effective agents (Dec 2024)

templates.name: Claude Code Playbook
templates.when_to_use: Teach the Explore → Plan → Code → Commit loop with the exact prompts and the thinking-budget keywords.
templates.dynamic: Phase arrows, growing thinking-budget bars, TDD loop-back arrow.
templates.lineage: Anthropic, Claude Code best practices (Apr 2025)

templates.name: Context Budget Ledger
templates.when_to_use: Show exactly where 200K tokens go and what compaction + just-in-time retrieval frees up.
templates.dynamic: Stacked ledgers grow; packets migrate from the bloated budget to the lean one.
templates.lineage: Anthropic, Effective context engineering (Sep 2025)

templates.name: Error Analysis Board
templates.best_for_short: Evals that start from real traces
templates.when_to_use: Walk a team from 100 traces to a failure taxonomy, a Pareto, and a binary judge per failure mode.
templates.dynamic: Notes flow into taxonomy buckets; Pareto bars grow.
templates.lineage: Hamel Husain & Shreya Shankar, AI Evals method

templates.name: Judge Calibration Card
templates.when_to_use: Before anyone quotes a judge score: confusion matrix vs humans, known biases, the fix for each, a prompt skeleton.
templates.dynamic: Matrix cells reveal in sequence; bias → fix arrows carry packets.
templates.lineage: Eugene Yan • Shreya Shankar • MT-Bench (Zheng et al. 2023)

templates.name: Trajectory Scorecard
templates.when_to_use: Explain how to grade an agent's tool-call sequence, not just its final answer.
templates.dynamic: Packets step through expected vs actual calls; metric rows compute live.
templates.lineage: Google, Agents Companion whitepaper (Feb 2025)

templates.name: How-It-Works Walkthrough
templates.when_to_use: A ByteByteGo-style numbered walkthrough of a protocol or system, one message per step.
templates.dynamic: Numbered messages light up in order with packets between lanes.
templates.lineage: Alex Xu / ByteByteGo format • MCP specification

templates.name: Sketch Explainer
templates.when_to_use: A warm, sketched comparison of 5 options (here: chunking strategies) with 'start with' defaults.
templates.dynamic: Scissor packets travel the cut lines; tilted cards; marker typography.
templates.lineage: Avi Chawla & Akshay Pachaar sketch format • Anthropic Contextual Retrieval (Sep 2024)

templates.name: AI by Hand
templates.when_to_use: Readers verify the math themselves: here Cohen's kappa for judge vs human agreement on grid paper.
templates.dynamic: Steps reveal one by one; a packet traces the computation path.
templates.lineage: Tom Yeh, AI by Hand format

templates.name: Paper of the Day
templates.when_to_use: One paper, one recreated chart, problem/method/result, caveats, and a read/skim/skip verdict.
templates.dynamic: Chart bars grow; verdict gauge fills; method pipeline carries a packet.
templates.lineage: Pascal Biese (LLM Watch) & Elvis Saravia (DAIR.AI) digest format

templates.name: Runnable Demo Card
templates.when_to_use: Show real code, the real output, and what it proves — then the clone command.
templates.dynamic: Terminal output types in line by line; a packet runs down the code gutter.
templates.lineage: Shubham Saboo (awesome-llm-apps) & Nir Diamant demo-repo format

templates.name: Ng's Four Patterns
templates.when_to_use: Explain why agentic loops beat bigger models with the HumanEval chart and the four design patterns.
templates.dynamic: Bars grow to 95.1%; each pattern has a live mini-loop.
templates.lineage: Andrew Ng, Sequoia AI Ascent (Mar 2024)

templates.name: Jagged Frontier Map
templates.when_to_use: Place concrete tasks inside/outside the capability frontier and show how to redraw it monthly.
templates.dynamic: Frontier edge pulses with orbiting packets.
templates.lineage: Ethan Mollick, jagged frontier (Dell'Acqua et al. 2023)

templates.name: Lethal Trifecta Venn
templates.when_to_use: Any agent that has private data + untrusted content + outbound comms can be made to leak; show which leg to remove.
templates.dynamic: Packets from each circle converge on a pulsing danger core.
templates.lineage: Simon Willison, The lethal trifecta for AI agents (Jun 2025)

templates.name: Orchestrator + Subagents
templates.when_to_use: Explain lead/subagent fan-out and when 15x tokens is worth it, with Anthropic's reported numbers.
templates.dynamic: Spawn packets fan out and results fan back in to synthesis.
templates.lineage: Anthropic, How we built our multi-agent research system (Jun 2025)

templates.name: Cost Waterfall
templates.when_to_use: Decompose cost per task into tokens, tools, retries, judges — then show the four levers.
templates.dynamic: Waterfall bars drop in sequence; a scan packet crosses the chart.
templates.lineage: Chip Huyen-style practical AI economics

templates.name: Incident Postmortem
templates.when_to_use: Tell the $84 retry-storm story on a timeline and name the control that would have stopped it at each step.
templates.dynamic: Severity packets run down the timeline; green control cards attach per event.
templates.lineage: Google SRE postmortem format applied to AgentOps

templates.name: Tool Spec Clinic
templates.when_to_use: Bad vs good tool JSON side by side with the five rules from Anthropic's tool-writing guide.
templates.dynamic: Transformation arrows jump from each flaw to its fix.
templates.lineage: Anthropic, Writing effective tools for agents (Sep 2025)

templates.name: Memory Design Matrix
templates.when_to_use: One request touches four memory types; decide what to store where, with freshness rules.
templates.dynamic: A request packet touches each memory store before the agent acts.
templates.lineage: CoALA (Sumers et al. 2023) • Lilian Weng (2023) • Aishwarya Naresh Reganti memory infographics

templates.name: One-Chart Changelog
templates.when_to_use: One metric over time, four annotated architecture changes, what each changed — build-in-public style.
templates.dynamic: The line draws progressively; flags appear as the line reaches them.
templates.lineage: Nate B. Jones 'one chart' • Santiago Valdarrama build-in-public
